fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2026-08-08 states that the complainant was stopped on a stretch near Vetri Layout Industrial Area by a few persons and a purse was taken, on 2026-08-08 at roughly 23:45. Dharani Anand approached Coimbatore North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000114. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Elango Shankar, using the number 9000000317. A car bearing the number TN-39-ZZ-1044 was seen leaving the area. A witness, Kavitha Selvam, reachable on 9000000099, was mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects reportedly followed the victim before stopping the vehicle.
